rules.title: Source of Income Discrimination Prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords, sellers, and rental agents are prohibited from discriminating against applicants based on their source of income, which explicitly includes Section 8 and public benefits.

coverage.summary: Applies to housing in Cambridge, with an exemption for owner-occupied 2-family dwellings.
coverage.owner_condition: Exempts 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.

rules.exemptions: 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
